description: This file defines the class GetBucketLocationResultMutator, a custom mutator for handling the GetBucketLocation operation in AWS S3 SDK for PHP. It extracts the bucket location from the HTTP response and injects it into the result object as 'LocationConstraint'.

classes.name: GetBucketLocationResultMutator
classes.description: A final class that implements a custom mutator for processing the result of a GetBucketLocation request in AWS S3, extracting location info from the HTTP response.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the mutator to extract the location constraint from the HTTP response and modifies the result accordingly.
